prompt: When the vet asked why the bulldog had a bright pink nose, the owner (say / tell) her that he had eaten a tube of lipstick.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу указывается адресат (told her), в отличие от say.

prompt: A listener phoned the morning show and (say / tell) that a stray goat was blocking traffic near the roundabout.
explanation_ru: Если адресат речи не указан сразу после глагола, используется say (said that).

prompt: As smoke filled the kitchen, Leo (say / tell) everyone the truth about using salt instead of sugar in the birthday cake.
explanation_ru: С существительным the truth используется устойчивое сочетание tell the truth, а также указан адресат (everyone).

prompt: The railway officer called the businessman to (say / tell) him that a cleaner had found his briefcase with his passport inside.
explanation_ru: После глагола следует прямое дополнение-адресат (tell him), поэтому выбираем tell.

prompt: The farmer phoned the vet at dawn and (say / tell) that two cows had escaped into the neighbor's cabbage field.
explanation_ru: Адресат после глагола отсутствует, поэтому для введения придаточного предложения с that используется said.

prompt: Maya finally (say / tell) her dad that she had used his favorite mug for her art project and stained it blue.
explanation_ru: Конструкция tell + адресат + that (told her dad that) требует глагола tell.

prompt: Ten minutes before curtain up, the stage manager (say / tell) the understudy that the lead actor had lost his voice.
explanation_ru: Глагол tell требует указания собеседника без предлога (told the understudy).

prompt: Over apple strudel and coffee, Clara (say / tell) to her friend, 'I got the job in Vienna!'
explanation_ru: Перед предлогом to с указанием адресата (said to her friend) и прямой речью используется глагол say.

prompt: One coworker whispered and (say / tell) that the surprise farewell cake had the wrong name spelled on top.
explanation_ru: Поскольку адресат не назван, используется конструкция said that.

prompt: Elena (say / tell) her trainer a funny excuse about why she had skipped all her stretching exercises last week.
explanation_ru: С существительным excuse (оправдание/отговорка) и указанием адресата используется глагол tell (told her trainer an excuse).

prompt: When a student found a Roman coin under a lunch box, the director rushed over to (say / tell) the team about it.
explanation_ru: После глагола сразу идет объект-адресат (the team), поэтому нужен глагол tell.

prompt: The receptionist (say / tell) that the sea-view room was still being painted and upgraded us to the rooftop suite.
explanation_ru: Глагол say используется, когда сразу после него идет союз that без упоминания собеседника.

prompt: During the interview, the manager asked Anna to (say / tell) a few words in Dutch. Anna paused and (say / tell) the interviewer honestly that she did not speak the language yet. She (say / tell) that her resume had overestimated her skills.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом выражении say a few words используется say; перед адресатом (the interviewer) ставится told; перед that без адресата — said.

prompt: While cleaning an old wooden desk, Sam found a hidden drawer full of love letters from 1920. He (say / tell) to his colleague that they looked priceless. Together, they decided to (say / tell) the museum director about their discovery right away.
explanation_ru: Перед предлогом to (said to his colleague) употребляется say, а перед прямым адресатом без предлога (tell the museum director) — tell.

prompt: Before rehearsal, the drummer (say / tell) the singer that the neighbors had complained about the bass amplifier. He (say / tell), 'We have to use headphones tonight.' The singer agreed and (say / tell) him that it was a fair rule.
explanation_ru: С указанием адресата (the singer, him) используется told, а для введения прямой речи без адресата — said.

prompt: At the start of the lesson, the teacher (say / tell) that the trip to the science museum was moved to Friday. She (say / tell) the students that the school bus needed urgent repairs. Nobody (say / tell) a word of complaint.
explanation_ru: Без адресата перед that ставится said; перед адресатом (the students) — told; в выражении say a word используется say.

prompt: At midnight, a rare night-blooming cactus opened two weeks early in the greenhouse. The assistant rushed to call the professor to (say / tell) him the exciting news. He (say / tell) that the petals would close again at dawn.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell идет адресат (tell him), тогда как перед that без указания слушателя используется said.

prompt: When a giant cardboard box arrived at the door, Claire laughed and (say / tell) her husband what was inside. She (say / tell) that she had accidentally ordered fifty rolls of toilet paper instead of five. He just smiled and (say / tell) nothing.
explanation_ru: С адресатом (her husband) употребляется told; перед придаточным с that — said; в устойчивой фразе say nothing используется said.

prompt: At the finish line, a volunteer draped a foil blanket over the runner's shoulders. He (say / tell) her that her family was waiting near the fountain. The tired athlete smiled and (say / tell) thank you.
explanation_ru: Перед адресатом (her) ставится told, а в устойчивом выражении благодарности say thank you используется said.

prompt: Mom accidentally sent a voice message to the family group and ___ everyone what she had bought for their birthdays.
explanation_ru: Глагол tell используется без предлога to перед адресатом (told everyone).

prompt: The bus driver opened the door for the soaked passenger and ___ that the card machine was broken anyway.
explanation_ru: Если после глагола сразу идет придаточное с that без упоминания адресата, нужен глагол said.

prompt: The gate agent announced over the loudspeaker and ___ passengers that the flight was delayed by three hours due to fog.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу следует адресат без предлога (told passengers).

prompt: Jake checked his phone and ___ his roommate that their morning chemistry exam was cancelled because the heating broke.
explanation_ru: С указанием собеседника без предлога (his roommate) правильно использовать told.

prompt: When the first snow of winter fell outside, she phoned her sister in Florida and said her all about it.
answer: When the first snow of winter fell outside, she phoned her sister in Florida and told her all about it.
accepted_answers: When the first snow of winter fell outside, she phoned her sister in Florida and told her all about it.
explanation_ru: Глагол say не употребляется напрямую с местоимением-адресатом (her); здесь нужен глагол told.

prompt: During the meeting, one designer whispered and told that the boss was wearing two different shoes today.
answer: During the meeting, one designer whispered and said that the boss was wearing two different shoes today.
accepted_answers: During the meeting, one designer whispered and said that the boss was wearing two different shoes today.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell обязательно должен быть указан собеседник; если его нет, используется said that.

prompt: Lily called her dad at work and told him that their missing hamster had just walked out from behind the fridge.
answer: Lily called her dad at work and told him that their missing hamster had just walked out from behind the fridge.
accepted_answers: Lily called her dad at work and told him that their missing hamster had just walked out from behind the fridge.
explanation_ru: Предложение построено верно: после глагола told сразу идет адресат (him) без предлога.

prompt: The young gardener confessed and said to the mayor that she had accidentally pulled up his prize tomatoes.
answer: The young gardener confessed and said to the mayor that she had accidentally pulled up his prize tomatoes.
accepted_answers: The young gardener confessed and said to the mayor that she had accidentally pulled up his prize tomatoes.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: глагол say может использоваться с указанием адресата, если перед ним стоит предлог to (said to the mayor).

prompt: The guest praises the mushroom soup, and the host admits she actually bought it from a shop down the street.
options: The host told her guest that she had bought the soup from a local shop.
The host said her guest that she had bought the soup from a local shop.
The host told to her guest that she had bought the soup from a local shop.
The host told that she had bought the soup from a local shop.
explanation_ru: Единственно верная модель — tell + адресат без предлога + that (told her guest that).

prompt: The owner checks his security camera and tells the detective exactly when a man cut the lock on a blue electric bike.
options: The owner told the detective the exact time the thief cut the lock.
The owner said the detective the exact time the thief cut the lock.
The owner told to the detective the exact time the thief cut the lock.
The owner said the exact time to the detective him.
explanation_ru: Правильно использовать конструкцию tell + собеседник + дополнение (told the detective the exact time).

prompt: Rewrite the sentence using 'told' instead of 'said to': Ben said to his sister that he had left the barn gate unlocked last night.
answer: Ben told his sister that he had left the barn gate unlocked last night.
accepted_answers: Ben told his sister that he had left the barn gate unlocked last night.
explanation_ru: При замене said to на told предлог to убирается, и адресат ставится сразу после глагола: told his sister.
